sentences.en: When the musicians threw t-shirts into the audience, pandemonium ensued.
sentences.zh: 音乐家向观众扔T恤时，现场一片混乱。

sentences.en: This sentence was born from indecisiveness and ensuing boredom.
sentences.zh: 这句话源于犹豫不决，并随之而来的无聊。

sentences.en: Tears ensue, / and wailing, shrill as though her heart would bleed.
sentences.zh: 泪水随之而来，/ 哭声尖锐得仿佛她的内心在流血。

senses.zh: 跟着发生，接着发生；继起
